_comment: Provenance for the binary client assets this zpak ships beside the phase ADTs.
*.m2/*.skin/*.blp are gitignored, so this file is the record of where each came from (F-203 shape).
Every entry is a plain library copy (already MD20 v264, no edits): copy base.source to
mpq/source-assets/<key> and mpq/parsed-assets/<KEY upper-cased>, then `zep build patch-mpq -p T --build`.
